# Character Card V3 Specification

This directory archives the Character Card V3 specification from
<https://github.com/kwaroran/character-card-spec-v3>, pinned to commit
`f3a86af019fbd99f788f7a1155f399655b34ab35`.

Copyright (c) 2024 Kwaroran.

The upstream specification is available under the MIT License. Its complete
license text is included in `LICENSE`. The Adapter uses the specification as a
data-format reference and accepts only a small, non-executable JSON subset.
